Solution Engineer II (AI/ML lead)

Job Title

AI/ML Lead | Edge AI | Computer Vision | NVIDIA Jetson

Key Skills

Computer Vision, Edge AI, NVIDIA Jetson, TensorFlow, PyTorch, TensorRT, CUDA, Python, C++, ONNX, Deep Learning, ML Architecture

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced AI/ML Lead with 8-12 years of experience to design, develop, and deploy AI solutions across edge and cloud platforms. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in Computer Vision, Deep Learning, Edge AI, and AI solution architecture, along with experience leading engineering teams and delivering production-grade AI systems.

Responsibilities

Design and architect end-to-end AI/ML solutions from edge to cloud.
Develop and optimize Computer Vision and Deep Learning models.
Deploy AI models on NVIDIA Jetson, Snapdragon, or similar edge platforms.
Lead and mentor AI engineering teams.
Work with customers and internal teams to define AI solution architectures.
Optimize models using TensorRT, CUDA, ONNX, and related technologies.

Required Skills

8-12 years of experience in AI/ML.
Strong hands-on experience with TensorFlow and/or PyTorch.
Expertise in Computer Vision (Object Detection, Segmentation, Pose Estimation, etc.).
Experience with NVIDIA Jetson and Edge AI deployments.
Strong Python and C++ programming skills.
Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, MLOps, and AI deployment.

Good to Have

AWS SageMaker / Azure ML
DeepStream, SNPE, OpenCL
Research publications in Computer Vision

Location

Noida

About eInfochips

eInfochips, an Arrow Electronics company, is a global leader in product engineering and semiconductor design services, delivering innovative solutions across AI, IoT, Embedded Systems, Cloud, and Digital Technologies.
